visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short haircut is shown bare-chested with blue athletic tape applied in a cross pattern on his chest and arms. He has black markings on his face. Behind him, a woman in a white button-down shirt and blue jeans walks on a concrete outdoor area. (2) The camera zooms in on a silver smartwatch on the man's wrist showing a timer or workout interface. The background is a rural outdoor setting with grey skies. (3) The man is seen running on a paved road flanked by green rice fields and a concrete drainage ditch. He is sweating and the black lines on his face are slightly smudged. (4) Two women are seated indoors on a light-colored sofa. They are holding red plastic cups of shaved ice or dessert and eating with plastic spoons. They are smiling and talking. (5) The man continues running outdoors, showing signs of fatigue. He looks directly into the camera while talking. Cars pass by on the adjacent road. (6) The scene shifts back to the women indoors who are laughing and enjoying their cold dessert. (7) It begins to rain lightly. The man's face is shown in a tight close-up; his eyes are squinted as sweat and rainwater mix with the markings on his face. (8) Final shots show the women finishing their dessert while the man is still running in the distance.
